text:
Kai: Thinking about a 'staged fallback' pattern for rollouts: three levels (sampled_soft -> held-back_shard -> full_degrade). Idea is to surface low-risk signals first and give operators progressive options.
Monica: Nice. Define triggers per level please: sampled_soft on short spikes, held-back_shard for sustained regressions, full_degrade for catastrophic. Need clear metric windows.
Ibrahim: Proposal: sampled_soft triggers on immediate error spike (>4% in 60s) or p95 increase > 30% in 30s. held-back_shard fires if error_rate > 2% for 10m or quality drift > 1.5% on golden prompts. full_degrade is manual or on SLA breach.
Jules: UX: timeline should show three distinct pills with colours (ivory -> amber -> red). Each pill links to the policy and a compact diff viewer. Also add a small "Why" tooltip that shows the exact trigger and metric snapshot.
Kai: API sketch (flat fields): fallback_mode: staged, stages: [sampled_soft, held_shard, hard], sampling_fraction: 0.01, hold_shard_fraction: 0.10, triggers: concise rules (we'll RFC). billing_policy: per_stage (default: bill where compute runs). audit_export: daily CSV with stable reason codes.
Monica: Edge case: held_shard could amplify a latent regression if the held shard is routed to slower hardware. Need an auto-check that compares held_shard p95 to baseline; if worse by X% revert the held route.
Ibrahim: Deterministic sampling is required for replay. Suggest sample_key = HMAC(seed, request_id || prompt_hash) < threshold. Persist decision_id in trace and use same seed for replays.
Jules: Console actions: "Promote stage", "Rollback stage", "Snooze stage (1h/24h)", and "Open sample comparer". All should append an audit event with operator, reason, and optional ticket link.
Kai: Telemetry fields to add (optional): fallback_stage, decision_id, sample_seed, reason_code. Keep each emission < 1kb. Also include prompt_hash + response_hash (sha256) only for sampled items.
Monica: Audit export format: daily CSV rows: timestamp, rollout_id, stage, reason_code, decision_id, prompt_hash, response_hash, model_before, model_after, operator_override, note. Encrypt at rest, retention configurable per org.
Ibrahim: Implementation note: sampling decision must be computed at the edge proxy; hold-shard routing can be done via internal routing table updates. Avoid extra RPCs on hot path.
Jules: Replay UI should allow selecting a sampled request, run it sandboxed against both routes, and show a compact summary: token-diff %, semantic-score delta, latency delta, and a link to open full diff (if artifacts stored). Respect consent flags.
ops-bot: Recorded: rollout-stage created -> id=rs-3999001234, step=sampled_soft.
Kai: Billing nuance: default billing is where compute occurred. Provide an operator toggle to 'charge original' for accounting baked into the rollout config. Surface estimated delta cost in the UI before enabling a stage.
Monica: Alerting: if sampled diffs exceed threshold over N samples, automatically open Runbook stub and notify SRE + product. Provide a one-click 'Acknowledge & Snooze' from the alert.
Ibrahim: QA: unit tests for sampling determinism, integration for staged transition and revert, e2e that exercises audit CSV generation and replay.
Jules: Accessibility: ensure stage pills have text fallback and colour-blind friendly patterns. Also keyboard actions for promote/rollback.
Kai: I'll draft the RFC with API shapes, telemetry additions, UI mockups, and runbook snippets. Assigning @Ibrahim for sampling impl and tests, @Jules for mockups and accessibility checks, @Monica for alert rules and audit retention policy.
ui-bot: Mockup checklist created: MK-7821 (timeline pills, sample comparer, confirm modals).
Kai: Thanks team. I'll include a short appendix on privacy: hashes only by default, raw artifacts require explicit opt-in and legal review.
